body:
Source: the release review of v1.11.1..main, re-verified on branch claude-review. Six defects in @adlc/core:
(a) packages/core/lib/railpath.mjs resolveRailPath joined the tool path with path.join before resolving any symlink, so `src/alias/../test/a.test.mjs` (alias -> ../test) folded to `src/test/a.test.mjs` while the kernel writes `test/a.test.mjs`; `node_modules/@adlc/core/../../.adlc/tickets/x.json` folded to `node_modules/.adlc/tickets/x.json`. The pi and opencode rails checkers glob-match only the returned string and allowed both writes.
(b) The same walk used existsSync, which follows links, so a dangling symlink `alias.mjs -> test/new.test.mjs` was stepped over and returned as `alias.mjs`; writing it creates `test/new.test.mjs` inside the rail.
(c) packages/core/lib/text.mjs fence() threw on an unknown bias value but accepted any opts shape: `fence(l, c, n, 'head')`, `['head']`, `{ Bias: 'head' }`, `{ biais: 'head' }` all silently kept tail truncation.
(d) packages/core/lib/mutate.mjs VALUE_ASSIGNMENT_RE anchored on `^\s*const`, so `export const NAME = f();` produced no mutant and a diff touching only such a line was refused as unverifiable; and the only test of the fallback's no-double-cover guard used `if (a > b) {`, which the fallback pattern never matches, so removing the guard failed no dedicated test.
(e) packages/core/lib/git.mjs churn() and coChange() parsed newline-separated `git log --name-only`, where git C-quotes any path with a non-ASCII byte, a double quote or a control character; `src/señal.mjs` became `\"src/se\\303\\261al.mjs\"`, matched no walker key, and scored zero churn / no coupling with exit 0.
(f) packages/core/lib/llm.mjs agySend wrote the prompt to agy's stdin with no stream error listener; an agy that exits before draining a prompt larger than the pipe buffer crashed the caller with an uncaught `write EPIPE` instead of rejecting with `agy exit N: <stderr>`.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/core`: lib/railpath.mjs (resolveRailPath, imported by plugins/adlc-pi/lib/rails-checker.mjs and plugins/adlc-opencode/rails-checker.mjs), lib/text.mjs (fence), lib/mutate.mjs (generateMutants, used by hollow-test and scripts/mutation-gate.mjs), lib/git.mjs (churn used by packages/model-ratchet, coChange used by packages/merge-forecast; splitNulPaths already exists), lib/llm.mjs (complete/agySend). Tests: `npm test -w packages/core`. Use `tmp(t, prefix)` from lib/test-kit.mjs for fixtures. lib/shell.mjs, lib/test-kit.mjs and index.d.ts are not part of this change.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. resolveRailPath walks the path segments left to right from the realpath of the root (or the filesystem root for an absolute input), lstat-ing each segment while the prefix exists: a symlink (dangling included) is replaced by its readlink target (absolute targets restart at the filesystem root) before the next segment; `..` applies to the resolved prefix; once a segment is missing the rest is appended lexically. More than 40 symlink hops (the Linux MAXSYMLINKS bound) or a link that vanishes mid-walk falls back to the lexical path, as the existing loop test requires. Output stays forward-slash and relative to the realpath of the root.
2. fence() accepts opts as undefined, null, or a plain object (prototype Object.prototype or null) whose only key is `bias`; any other shape throws `fence: opts must be a plain object, got: <type>` and any other key throws `fence: unknown option(s): <keys>`. The bias value check is unchanged.
3. VALUE_ASSIGNMENT_RE admits an optional `export` prefix; let/var and sentinel-bound (`undefined`/`null`) exports stay excluded, and the fallback still fires only on lines no primary operator mutated.
4. churn() and coChange() read `git log -n <limit> --name-only -z --pretty=format:/` as a buffer, split with splitNulPaths (undecodable names throw), and treat a field beginning with `/` as the per-commit marker (a repo-relative path never begins with `/`). Keys are the real repo-relative paths.
5. agySend registers a stdin error listener. A non-zero exit rejects with `agy exit N: ...` as before; an exit 0 after a stdin write error rejects with `agy did not read the full prompt: <message>`.
6. Documentation: packages/core/README.md documents fence's opts argument. apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/core.mdx does not describe fence and needs no edit.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `..` after a symlinked directory, a `..` climb through a package symlink, and dangling file/dir/absolute symlinks resolve to the path the kernel writes; the 40-hop bound holds at both edges. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/railpath-kernel-order.test.mjs packages/core/test/railpath.test.mjs packages/core/test/railpath-deep-ancestor.test.mjs`
- AC2 fence rejects a positional string, array, number, boolean, function, misspelled key, wrong-case key and extra key, and accepts undefined, null, {}, { bias } and a null-prototype object. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/fence-opts-shape.test.mjs packages/core/test/text.test.mjs`
- AC3 `export const tag = randomUUID();` yields exactly one value-substitute mutant, and `const limit = 3;` / `const ok = a > b;` yield exactly one primary mutant each. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/mutate-value-substitute.test.mjs`
- AC4 churn and coChange count `señal.mjs`, `say "hi".mjs`, `with space.mjs`, `--COMMIT--` and `undefined.mjs` under their real names. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/git-log-nonascii-paths.test.mjs && npm test -w packages/model-ratchet && npm test -w packages/merge-forecast`
- AC5 An agy that closes stdin and exits 1 rejects with `agy exit 1: auth error` and the caller does not crash; one that exits 0 without reading is rejected; one that reads and exits 0 resolves. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/llm-agy-stdin.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suites green. verify: `npm test -w packages/core && node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-opencode/test/*.test.mjs && npm test -w packages/hollow-test`
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: the forked resolvers in plugins/adlc-cursor/rails-checker.mjs and plugins/adlc-gemini/rails-checker.mjs, and the resolve-first path handling in the claude-code, codex and copilot hooks (same `..`-after-symlink class, separate change); spawn and fetch timeouts in lib/llm.mjs; lib/shell.mjs, lib/test-kit.mjs, index.d.ts.
title: core: resolve rail paths in kernel order and fix four silent-default gaps
